script_text: Pisces, your Neptune-ruled Water heart meets a career breakthrough this week. Monday, the Sun enters Sagittarius, lighting your 10th House, while Jupiter in Leo trines it from your 6th House, expanding public work visibility. Tuesday's Full Moon in Gemini activates your 4th House of home, forcing a decision about belonging. Wednesday, Venus in Scorpio squares Pluto in your 12th House from your 9th House, so love reveals a deep hidden truth through travel, study, or a late-night message. Late week, Mercury in Scorpio sharpens your 9th House travel and study deals, making negotiations clearer. Neptune's trine turns inspired ideas into practical 2nd House earning plans, especially around shared resources. Tuesday is your power day because the Gemini Full Moon culminates home. Sunday is hardest because Venus still squares Pluto, stirring very private emotional truth. Sign, send, and name what you want. Follow for daily updates.
